g.text: Claude Code, isolated like takt's harness

svg.text: outlined: a takt step taken by the harness (one model call)
dashed: no time recorded, placed in order between timed operations
seed pr.open: a pr.open step before any file changed
inspect, then NoProgress: a harness step that only read, then the NoProgress stop
2nd CI: the run's second passing CI read
Data: 2026-10-18 (UTC), docs/metrics/journeys.jsonl from the raw records each run in docs/metrics/scenario-runs.jsonl names. No token or cost
figure is read from the journeys. Free and isolated runs without a stream record only a turn count (Claude Code) or their items in order (Codex); runs
with a stream are timed. First results, not a benchmark.
